notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 93–197, § 2, Dec. 22, 1973, 87 Stat. 770, which set out definitions, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 93–197, § 1, Dec. 22, 1973, 87 Stat. 770, provided that Pub. L. 93–197, enacting this subchapter and repealing sections 891 to 902 of this title, could be cited as the “Menominee Restoration Act”.

ancestors.heading: MENOMINEE TRIBE OF WISCONSIN: RESTORATION OF FEDERAL SUPERVISION
